Recompute exact ratio, percentile with declared algorithm/weights/units, gauge with declared sampling/gaps. Population/coverage comes from independently bound expected inventory, never received sample count. Missing/zero/overflow/dropped/mixed-unbound release -> Indeterminate.

Retain legacy1.0.0 evaluator/JSON semantics as compatibility surface. New API's qualified result distinct; productionSloClaimed=false for all task fixtures even if candidate threshold passes. No new product thresholds.

Add case-owned deterministic clock/random, bounded script/inner counts, explicit retry pipeline placement, finite in-memory terminal, cancellation/exhaustion/cleanup failure semantics. Test-only, no production fault endpoint.

Bound capture count/time/bytes, case scope and lifecycle; reject cross-case contamination, preserve links and fan-out/retry/receive/apply DAG without deleting intermediate spans; local sequence not commit order.

Exact numeric capture/assertions distinguish CLR numeric kind, BigInteger coefficient/scale, rational, original lexical text and original bytes; never compare authoritative values through double/decimal or epsilon.

Consume fixed S01-03/04 semantics and vectors as input; no new financial contract authority or production reference to Main. Test fixture/source provenance pinned explicitly; source-link execution if used must hash-check exact Main sources and remain test-only.

Maintain compatibility of legacy recorder accessors, or offer opt-in versioned replacements; any removal/wire-contract change needs COORD contract window. Existing WP02-25 Incomplete telemetry cannot be silently qualified Complete.

Same actual frozen local evidence bytes/definition/window recompute same result; one-byte hash drift, altered denominator/query/units/exclusions, late-data overwrite, missing population, mixed release, zero samples reject or Indeterminate.

Unit/contract cases beyond2^53 and System.Decimal capacity, FIN-CREDIT38/8 and FIN-INV18/12 scale examples, native lexical signed-zero/trailing-zero distinctions and rational nonterminating values; no invented legal input narrowing.
Fanout + retry + intermediate Dapr span + receive/apply graph; duplicate/replayed operations, dangling/missing/cross-case edges rejected; max capture overflow and disposal prove no false Complete.
Fault harness verifies Status/Throw do not call inner; Success/Delay reach named in-memory terminal; cancellation/script exhaustion/observer failure and cleanup failure remain visible.

New real PG55429 concurrent transactions plus crash/restart on task-owned fixture only, retain same native operation/message keys and exact stored values; actual server crash labeled controlled failure and observed DB semantics, application ACK suppression distinctly injected.
